Package org.uma.evolver.example.tutorial

package org.uma.evolver.example.tutorial
  • Class
    Description
    AblationTutorial
    Ablation study of tutorial E12, "Ablation: which components matter" (see docs/tutorials/ablation.rst).
    BaseLevelAlgorithmsTutorial
    Code of tutorial E2, "Base-level algorithms" (see docs/tutorials/base_level_algorithms.rst).
    BiSphere
    A bi-objective problem of the user, as in tutorial E17, "Extending Evolver" (see docs/tutorials/extending_evolver.rst): minimize the squared distance to the origin and to the point (2, ..., 2).
    BudgetsTutorial
    Code of tutorial E11, "Budgets: evaluations or time" (see docs/tutorials/budgets.rst).
    BudgetsTutorial.Checkpoint
    A checkpoint of VAR_CONF.txt: the meta-evaluations done and the minutes elapsed.
    EncodingsTutorial
    Validation studies of tutorial E10 (binary and permutation encodings): the standard NSGA-II against NSGA-II with a configuration tuned by tutorial-encodings-binary-request.yaml and by tutorial-encodings-permutation-request.yaml, 25 independent runs each.
    ExtendingTutorial
    Code of tutorial E17, "Extending Evolver" (see docs/tutorials/extending_evolver.rst): a problem of the user, BiSphere, that Evolver does not know and that its requests refer to by class name.
    IraceTutorial
    Code of tutorial E15, "Tuning with irace" (see docs/tutorials/tuning_with_irace.rst).
    MetaOptimizationWorkflowTutorial
    Code of tutorial E3, "Meta-optimization workflow" (see docs/tutorials/meta_optimization_workflow.rst).
    MetaOptimizationWorkflowTutorial.TunedConfiguration
    A configuration found by the training, with its indicator values.
    ParameterSpaceDesignTutorial
    Validation study of tutorial E5 (designing your own parameter space): compares two configurations of NSGA-II tuned for the bi-objective WFG problems with the same training, one found in the full parameter space (NSGAIIDouble.yaml, the configuration of tutorial E8, NSGAIIWFG) and one in the much smaller space of Nebro et al., "Automatic Configuration of NSGA-II with jMetal and irace" (GECCO 2019 Companion), NSGAIIDoubleGECCO2019.yaml (NSGAIIWFGSmall), together with the standard NSGA-II.
    ParameterSpacesTutorial
    Code of tutorial E1, "Parameter spaces" (see docs/tutorials/parameter_spaces.rst).
    TrainingAnalysisTutorial
    Code of tutorial E7, "Analyzing training results" (see docs/tutorials/analyzing_training_results.rst).
    TrainingSetsValidationTutorial
    Validation study of tutorial E6 (training sets, indicators and budgets): compares the NSGA-II configuration found by AsyncNSGAIIOptimizingNSGAIIForBenchmarkDTLZ, trained on DTLZ1-7 with 10000 evaluations per problem, with the standard NSGA-II, NSGA-III, MOEA/D, SMS-EMOA and AGE-MOEA (their default configurations), with a budget usual for these problems: 50000 evaluations.
    TreeEncodingTutorial
    Code of tutorial E14, "Tree versus flat encoding" (see docs/tutorials/tree_versus_flat_encoding.rst).
    ValidationTutorial
    Validation study of tutorial E8 (validating a configuration), which repeats the one of Nebro et al., "Automatic Configuration of NSGA-II with jMetal and irace" (GECCO 2019 Companion) with a configuration found by Evolver instead of irace.
